sentence: Bless you! Are you getting a cold?
zh-TW: 保重！你是不是要感冒了？
tagging_notes: Bless you 是聽到別人打噴嚏時說的話

sentence: Which airline are you flying with?
zh-TW: 你搭哪一家航空公司？

sentence: The amendment to the law takes effect next month.
zh-TW: 法律修正案下個月生效。

sentence: My grandmother lives with us.
zh-TW: 我奶奶跟我們住在一起。

sentence: The jury will decide tomorrow.
zh-TW: 陪審團明天會做出決定。

sentence: Thank you for your cooperation.
zh-TW: 感謝您的配合。

sentence: He left the army and went back to civilian life.
zh-TW: 他退伍後回到一般老百姓的生活。
tagging_notes: civilian 在此為形容詞「平民的」

sentence: Our homework is to write a composition about summer.
zh-TW: 我們的功課是寫一篇關於夏天的作文。

sentence: I need some coins for the vending machine.
zh-TW: 我需要一些零錢投販賣機。
tagging_notes: coin 在此譯為「零錢（硬幣）」

sentence: We'll go regardless of the weather.
zh-TW: 不管天氣怎樣，我們都會去。

sentence: Please scan the QR code to order.
zh-TW: 請掃描 QR code 點餐。

sentence: He bought her a bunch of flowers.
zh-TW: 他買了一束花送她。

sentence: The school welcomes students of all racial backgrounds.
zh-TW: 這所學校歡迎各種族背景的學生。
tagging_notes: 2026-10-09 第一輪風險複審保留；主題：包容性教育

sentence: She greeted us at the door with a smile.
zh-TW: 她在門口笑著迎接我們。

sentence: Hopefully it won't rain tomorrow.
zh-TW: 希望明天不會下雨。
tagging_notes: hopefully 在此為句首副詞「但願」

sentence: The new sanctions will affect oil prices.
zh-TW: 新的制裁措施會影響油價。

sentence: Here's a simple trick to save time.
zh-TW: 這裡有個省時間的小技巧。

sentence: Please read the first paragraph aloud.
zh-TW: 請大聲念出第一段。

sentence: We bought a new coffee maker.
zh-TW: 我們買了一台新的咖啡機。
tagging_notes: maker 在此為「…機（製造器具）」

sentence: Would you like some hot chocolate?
zh-TW: 要不要喝點熱可可？

sentence: Reading can stimulate a child's imagination.
zh-TW: 閱讀能激發孩子的想像力。

sentence: Please fasten your seat belt.
zh-TW: 請繫好安全帶。

sentence: I'll have the steak with a baked potato.
zh-TW: 我要牛排配烤馬鈴薯。

sentence: His narrative of the trip was very funny.
zh-TW: 他講述這趟旅行的經過非常好笑。

sentence: The doctor took a small piece of tissue for testing.
zh-TW: 醫生取了一小塊組織去化驗。
tagging_notes: tissue 在此為生物「組織」；日常更常見「面紙」義

sentence: I could barely hear you.
zh-TW: 我幾乎聽不到你說話。

sentence: Who invented the telephone?
zh-TW: 電話是誰發明的？

sentence: Tourism is important for this island.
zh-TW: 觀光業對這座島很重要。

sentence: She plays tennis like a pro.
zh-TW: 她打網球打得像職業選手一樣。
tagging_notes: pro 在此為名詞「職業選手、高手」

sentence: Watch your step on the stairs.
zh-TW: 走樓梯時小心腳步。

sentence: Don't hesitate to ask if you have any questions.
zh-TW: 有任何問題的話，儘管問。

sentence: The sun is shining today.
zh-TW: 今天陽光普照。

sentence: I need some motivation to exercise.
zh-TW: 我需要一點運動的動力。

sentence: We had a romantic dinner by the sea.
zh-TW: 我們在海邊吃了一頓浪漫的晚餐。

sentence: Hold the handle firmly.
zh-TW: 緊緊抓住把手。

sentence: The interior of the car is very clean.
zh-TW: 這輛車的內部很乾淨。

sentence: I can't run on a full stomach.
zh-TW: 我剛吃飽，沒辦法跑步。

sentence: There's nowhere to park around here.
zh-TW: 這附近沒地方停車。

sentence: She prays before every meal.
zh-TW: 她每餐飯前都會禱告。

sentence: Our team won the championship this year.
zh-TW: 我們隊今年拿下了冠軍。

sentence: In the old days, rich families had many servants.
zh-TW: 以前有錢人家裡有很多僕人。

sentence: His grandparents came here as immigrants.
zh-TW: 他的祖父母當年是移民來這裡的。

sentence: You'll have to pay extra for excess baggage.
zh-TW: 行李超重要另外付費。
tagging_notes: excess 在此為形容詞「超額的」

sentence: Don't underestimate the complexity of this project.
zh-TW: 別低估了這個專案的複雜性。

sentence: The company has no liability for lost items.
zh-TW: 公司對遺失物品不負任何責任。
tagging_notes: liability 在此為法律上的「責任」

sentence: The test was surprisingly easy.
zh-TW: 這次考試出乎意料地簡單。

sentence: This app can extract text from photos.
zh-TW: 這個 app 能從照片中擷取文字。

sentence: The implementation of the new system will take months.
zh-TW: 新系統的實施要花好幾個月。

sentence: Every news report has some bias.
zh-TW: 每篇新聞報導多少都有些偏見。

sentence: We see things differently.
zh-TW: 我們看事情的角度不同。

sentence: You can order from our online catalog.
zh-TW: 您可以從我們的線上型錄訂購。

sentence: We've had continuous rain all week.
zh-TW: 整個星期雨下個不停。

sentence: The beach has soft golden sand.
zh-TW: 海灘上是柔軟的金黃色沙子。

sentence: I need a stamp for this letter.
zh-TW: 我需要一張郵票寄這封信。

sentence: Please follow the safety guidelines.
zh-TW: 請遵守安全守則。

sentence: Put the letter in the envelope.
zh-TW: 把信放進信封裡。

sentence: Could you pass me a knife?
zh-TW: 可以遞一把刀給我嗎？

sentence: My sister is studying biological sciences.
zh-TW: 我妹妹在讀生物科學。

sentence: This old fridge consumes a lot of power.
zh-TW: 這台舊冰箱很耗電。

sentence: Staying at that hotel was a real luxury.
zh-TW: 住那家飯店真是一大享受。
tagging_notes: luxury 在此為「奢侈的享受」

sentence: We have a weekly team meeting on Mondays.
zh-TW: 我們每週一開團隊週會。

sentence: Sit wherever you like.
zh-TW: 你想坐哪裡就坐哪裡。

sentence: Can I have a bite of your sandwich?
zh-TW: 可以讓我咬一口你的三明治嗎？

sentence: The printer is out of paper.
zh-TW: 印表機沒紙了。

sentence: Firstly, let me introduce myself.
zh-TW: 首先，讓我自我介紹一下。

sentence: I always feel anxious before exams.
zh-TW: 我考試前總是很焦慮。

sentence: The trip was a real adventure.
zh-TW: 這趟旅行真是一場冒險。

sentence: The dog jumped over the fence.
zh-TW: 狗跳過了圍欄。

sentence: We exhausted our budget in the first week.
zh-TW: 我們第一週就把預算花光了。

sentence: What's the main tourist attraction here?
zh-TW: 這裡主要的觀光景點是什麼？
tagging_notes: attraction 在此為「景點」，非「吸引力」

sentence: Our room has an ocean view.
zh-TW: 我們的房間看得到海景。

sentence: Please speak quietly in the library.
zh-TW: 圖書館裡請小聲說話。

sentence: We visited an old castle on the hill.
zh-TW: 我們參觀了山丘上的一座古堡。

sentence: My grandfather is a war veteran.
zh-TW: 我爺爺是退伍軍人。
tagging_notes: 2026-10-09 第一輪風險複審保留；主題：退伍軍人

sentence: This trip gave me time for reflection.
zh-TW: 這趟旅行讓我有時間反思。

sentence: Loud noise really gets on my nerves.
zh-TW: 吵雜的聲音真的讓我很煩。
tagging_notes: nerve 在此用於片語 get on one's nerves「惹人心煩」，非字面「神經」

sentence: Her determination helped her pass the exam.
zh-TW: 她的決心幫她通過了考試。

sentence: That's thirty dollars altogether.
zh-TW: 總共三十元。
tagging_notes: altogether 在此為「總共」，非「完全地」

sentence: I mostly read fiction.
zh-TW: 我大多讀小說。

sentence: I spilled coffee on the carpet.
zh-TW: 我把咖啡灑在地毯上了。

sentence: There's a cluster of small shops near the station.
zh-TW: 車站附近聚集了一些小店。

sentence: Sorry for the confusion.
zh-TW: 抱歉造成混淆。

sentence: Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.
zh-TW: 快點，不然我們會錯過公車。

sentence: I don't understand the logic behind this rule.
zh-TW: 我不懂這條規定背後的邏輯。

sentence: The movie's ending was controversial.
zh-TW: 這部電影的結局很有爭議。

sentence: Is this fish raw?
zh-TW: 這條魚是生的嗎？

sentence: My grammar still isn't perfect.
zh-TW: 我的文法還不夠完美。

sentence: Please revise the report by Friday.
zh-TW: 請在星期五前修改報告。

sentence: Can you give me a hint?
zh-TW: 可以給我一點提示嗎？

sentence: Hang your coat on the hook.
zh-TW: 把外套掛在掛鉤上。

sentence: Ring the bell if you need help.
zh-TW: 需要幫忙的話請按鈴。

sentence: You can't take liquids through security.
zh-TW: 液體不能帶過安檢。

sentence: Don't panic, we still have time.
zh-TW: 別慌，我們還有時間。

sentence: My uncle runs a small restaurant.
zh-TW: 我叔叔開了一家小餐廳。

sentence: I'd like fried rice, please.
zh-TW: 我要一份炒飯，謝謝。

sentence: This ski slope is too steep for me.
zh-TW: 這條滑雪道對我來說太陡了。

sentence: Money can't buy happiness.
zh-TW: 金錢買不到幸福。

sentence: Is this genuine leather?
zh-TW: 這是真皮嗎？
tagging_notes: genuine 在此為「真正的、非仿冒的」，非「真誠的」

sentence: The ancient vessel in the museum is made of clay.
zh-TW: 博物館裡那件古老的器皿是陶土做的。
tagging_notes: vessel 在此為「器皿」；也常指「船隻」

sentence: Every sentence needs a verb.
zh-TW: 每個句子都需要一個動詞。
